name: Signdeer Forms
author: Signdeer.com

sections.description:
Signdeer Forms is a thin WordPress connector. WordPress supplies a shortcode
or block mount point; Signdeer renders the published forms directory in an
iframe and owns form selection, modal presentation, onboarding, eKYC,
documents, payment, eSigning, and case data.

Features:

  • Current Signdeer hosted iframe integration
  • Same custom-website SDK contract and secure postMessage validation
  • Search, category tabs, selection, and form modal managed by Signdeer
  • Optional partner attribution through a domain-bound p7k key
  • Lazy iframe loading and content-hashed local plugin assets
  • No WordPress catalog cache, API token, or duplicate form data store

The shortcode always embeds the organization’s full published forms directory.
Category tabs belong to the Signdeer catalog; there is no category shortcode
or block filter.

Source and build

The readable SDK source is included in the plugin ZIP at
src/signdeer-forms-embed.ts; the readable host adapter is
assets/signdeer-forms-hosted.js. The build script is at
build/build-sdk.mjs and builds both included source files.

To rebuild the bundled SDK from the plugin directory, install Node.js and run:

  1. npm install --no-save esbuild
  2. node build/build-sdk.mjs

The script bundles the TypeScript SDK and the readable hosted adapter as
ES2018 browser IIFEs, writing assets/signdeer-forms-embed.min.js and
assets/signdeer-forms-hosted.min.js.

Privacy

When a visitor uses the hosted forms iframe, the browser communicates with
Signdeer over HTTPS and sends standard request information such as IP address
and user agent. The plugin does not receive or store the visitor’s identity,
documents, signatures, or case data. Update the site’s privacy notice as
needed.

Compatibility

The plugin ships the bundled custom-website embed SDK, so the WordPress
connector and custom integrations use the same iframe behavior. The plugin
loads its SDK from the plugin package. Custom website integrations use the
stable https://signdeer.com/embed-sdk-assets/signdeer-forms-embed.js URL.
The root-level /signdeer-embed.js and /signdeer-embed.css files may still be
generated by the app build, but they are not the integration URLs. The former
WordPress catalog/cache implementation is no longer part of the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the signdeer-forms folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Signdeer Forms in Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Open Settings → Signdeer Forms.
  4. Enter the Signdeer origin and organization slug.
  5. Optionally enter the domain-bound Partner portal p7k key.

  6. Add [signdeer_forms] to a page or post, or use a Signdeer forms block.

    [signdeer_directory] and [signdeer_links] remain shortcode aliases for
    existing pages. They use the same hosted iframe; they do not render a legacy
    WordPress catalog.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Added the readable SDK source and documented reproducible build tooling.
  • Corrected the Plugin URI and hardened URL and hostname setting sanitization.
  • Expanded plugin-owned class, constant, option, and embed attribute prefixes.

1.1.0

  • Rebuilt the public connector around the current hosted iframe and custom-website SDK.
  • Removed the legacy WordPress-rendered catalog, API cache, and duplicate iframe runtime.
  • Added lazy loading, content-hashed assets, and domain-bound partner attribution.
  • Kept shortcode and block names as hosted-iframe compatibility aliases.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
